title: The Absolute Effect - Master Trial Roster
rules: One entry represents one underlying trial/study, not one publication.
Trial aliases, acronyms, registry names and follow-up publications are collapsed into the same entry.
A trial-page entry counts as uploaded evidence.
A unique Trial-of-the-Day archived in data/trial-archive.json counts even if no permanent trial page exists.
Daily proposal files are not added merely because a trial was proposed; they must correspond to an uploaded trial page or archived Trial-of-the-Day to enter this roster.
Before future selection, this roster must be checked together with current Trial-of-the-Day and archive data.
After an approved daily batch is uploaded, the roster is updated the same day before subsequent daily selection.

Daily selection must avoid not only duplicate trials/studies but also consecutive trials that answer essentially the same clinical question; selection should maximize distinct clinical questions unless replication/evolution is deliberate.

Every trial page must remain visually informative when neither NNT nor NNH can be defensibly calculated: show a chart/pictogram of the strongest reported outcome (e.g. survival, response, progression, toxicity, or relative effect) using source-reported values only; label endpoint and time horizon; never derive NNT from median survival.

Every permanent trial page must distinguish historical trial results from current practice context. Audit for later follow-up publications, meta-analyses, guideline changes, and whether the intervention remains standard; display a dated current-practice context and linked sources. Do not overwrite original trial results with newer recommendations.

Do not mark a trial clinically current based only on its original publication date or presence of a source link. A freshness review must check subsequent follow-up, later practice-changing trials/meta-analyses, current disease-specific guideline recommendations, and whether the intervention remains standard; record dated sources and review status.

Every rostered and newly added trial page must be checked for an actual, readable outcome visualization: show a defensible NNT/NNH patient pictogram when possible; otherwise chart a source-reported survival, response, recurrence, toxicity, or relative-effect endpoint. Pages with no detectable numeric endpoint must be explicitly flagged for manual review rather than silently left as abstract-only. Never derive NNT from median survival.

missing_pages_added: SWENOTECA clinical stage I NSGCT management programme
audit.absolute_effect_rule: Show the absolute-effect pictogram when NNT or NNH is defensibly quantified. If neither is quantifiable, show a source-grounded graphical/pictorial view of the strongest reported outcome (survival, response, progression, toxicity, or relative effect); never infer NNT from median survival.
audit.outcome_visualization_rule: When no defensible numeric NNT/NNH is available, visualize the strongest reported outcome using source-reported values; never invent rates or derive NNT from median survival.
audit.outcome_visualization_implementation: Shared renderer automatically detects reported median survival comparisons, named endpoint percentage pairs, or hazard ratios when neither NNT nor NNH is quantified; trial template includes the same fallback for future pages.
audit.freshness_audit_scope: Clinical freshness review remains incomplete. Structural content screen completed for all 145 roster index pages on 2026-10-12; 280 HTML routes across 168 unique blobs exist and duplicate routes/live deployment remain to be verified.
audit.structural_content_screening_scope: All 145 master-roster trial-page index.html files were individually retrieved and screened for source-link presence, explicit current-practice/guideline context, generic boilerplate clinical interpretation, placeholder tokens, and visible publication years. Repository inventory also contains 280 trial-page HTML files across 168 unique HTML blobs.

structural_content_screening_findings.widespread_gap: Most roster index pages lack a clearly labelled, dated current-practice/guideline context section. Many still contain generic interpretation language; some pages lack an obvious primary-source URL using the screened common domains. Old publication years are not by themselves evidence of staleness.
structural_content_screening_findings.interpretation: This was a source-code/content heuristic screen, not a completed clinical evidence review. Each trial still requires checking latest follow-up, practice-changing trials, meta-analyses, and current guideline recommendations. Live Cloudflare deployment and every duplicate HTML route have not been verified.
structural_content_screening_findings.status: STRUCTURAL SCREEN COMPLETE; CLINICAL FRESHNESS AUDIT INCOMPLETE

audit.clinical_freshness_audit_status: IN PROGRESS — targeted context added to the new batch; full roster clinical review remains incomplete.
audit.clinical_currency_guard: Cloudflare Pages middleware injects a non-prescriptive clinical currency note into trial-page HTML routes.
audit.outcome_visual_qa_implementation: Shared renderer now inserts a visible manual-review flag when it cannot detect a supported numeric endpoint; the new trial-page template does the same for future pages. A repository-wide script audits every rostered canonical page and every HTML file under trial-pages, and a GitHub Actions workflow runs it on trial-page/template/renderer/roster changes. The heuristic report is not a substitute for source-level clinical verification.
audit.outcome_visual_page_by_page_audit_status: New batch has outcome charts in HTML; automated and browser-rendered visual QA remains pending.
audit.outcome_visual_review_status: Shared renderer/template safeguards and automated audit are committed. Every roster entry is explicitly marked pending until the generated page-level audit is reviewed and each page's actual visual is confirmed.
audit.prostate_oligometastatic_batch_note: Added source-linked trial pages for the requested prostate RT/MDT list. PEACE-1 already existed and was expanded with its prostate-radiotherapy comparison rather than duplicated. OLIGOPELVIS and TRAP are single-arm studies, not randomized ENRT-vs-INRT or MDT-vs-systemic-therapy comparisons.

targeted_stale_page_check.status: Targeted content/source check recorded for the 10 new pages; browser-render and live deployment checks pending.
